sp500.note: Community-maintained S&P 500 constituent dataset, sourced from Wikipedia; not an official S&P feed.

moex.note: Issuer names from MOEX ISS. A broad issuer sample, not a size ranking. Latin aliases maintained separately in russian_companies.csv.

russian_curated.note: Curated Russian company names, local brands, services and historical names with candidate Latin spellings; not an official register or ownership verification.
